environment.app: Local web renderer with real Better Auth and server functions
environment.gate: Enabled only for the isolated acceptance app

evidence: Real Better Auth login in two independent owner browser contexts and a third account
Saved General and Calls values survive owner reload; other account stays at defaults
Workspace Inbox changes survive owner reload; dedicated SQL fixtures verify another workspace and account cannot read or write them
Request identity comes from the session; arbitrary owner IDs, keys/agents and protected/unknown nested fields are rejected
Independent SQL field races preserve both edits
Exactly one same-field concurrent SQL write succeeds; stale/mixed patches change no fields
Browser displays the conflict and requires explicit discard/review before more edits
Scalar/nested object leaves are independent; arrays are atomic fields
Actual browser offline save shows unsaved status and reconnect retries successfully
Lost-response receipt replay in another owner session creates one effect; changed input is rejected
Client lifecycle tests discard queued writes on account/sign-out changes and ignore late completions
A real SQL test switches the active workspace without changing session ID and rejects a queued old-workspace patch
Scoped caches validate owner/workspace/version and preserve legacy or damaged sources
Injected audit failure rolls preference and receipt back together; same-key retry succeeds
Revoked sessions cannot replay protected receipts
Receipt contains only owner/revision; audit contains no preference fields/values; outbox remains empty
Unknown stored values survive unrelated patches; future server schema versions reject edits

browserAcceptance.runtime: Node v24; Chromium; real application authentication and SQL

releaseBoundary: No production migration, deployment or connection-pointer change
Shared staging database unchanged; expansion applied only to dedicated acceptance database
Feature gate defaults off; enablement requires an accepted release
Web and Electron share the renderer/client; no packaged-macOS certification claimed
Legacy browser import remains FOR-144; no ownership inference or automatic upload
Preferences do not grant permissions, rewrite team policy or implement downstream behavior stories
Pending patches remain in the current renderer and are discarded on sign-out/account/workspace change; they are not persisted across closing it
